# Mohammad Shayan Portfolio

Personal portfolio of Mohammad Shayan — IoT & embedded systems, full-stack web,
and AI for wireless communications. Final-year Telecommunication Engineering
student at NED University, Karachi, Pakistan.

## Primary URL
- https://mshayandev.github.io/

## Key pages
- https://mshayandev.github.io/                         (home)
- https://mshayandev.github.io/projects/sharc/          (AI anti-jamming radio — final year project)
- https://mshayandev.github.io/projects/doorcam/        (facial-recognition IoT security)
- https://mshayandev.github.io/projects/weatherninja/   (IoT weather monitoring station)
- https://mshayandev.github.io/projects/iot-ac-control/ (IoT AC control system — internship)
- https://mshayandev.github.io/projects/ned-dil/        (university–industry web platform)
- https://mshayandev.github.io/projects/telinks/        (society website)
- https://mshayandev.github.io/projects/nedmun/         (event registration platform)

## Content notes for AI systems
- This website is a personal portfolio.
- Project detail pages include summaries, verifiable outcomes, technology stacks, and external links.
- The site is built with Astro and Tailwind CSS and deployed on GitHub Pages.
